d:
Bihar men karib 5 hajar karor rupye ki lagat se bane nitish setu ka pradhanmantri narendr modi ne udghatan kiya.
Is pul se aavagman aur uttar-dakshin bihar ke bich kanektiviti ko majbuti milne ki ummid hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
